On this episode of Chart Fanatics, we are joined by institutional trader Matteo Conti. After making more than €30 million for the bank and running hundreds of strategies simultaneously, Matteo explains how institutional traders find, test and validate trading edges before putting real capital behind them.

He breaks down the research and process behind a simple 1-minute strategy that returned 671% over five years in the study he discusses.

He also breaks down opening-range momentum, VWAP, post-earnings drift, overnight market behaviour and how retail and prop-firm traders can use research to build more systematic trading strategies.
